exemptions: This repository is a CLI/library; endpoint, database, MCP, and UI product surfaces are out of scope for this fix.

contract.intent: Harden the code-review library for bounded GitHub PR reviews, reliable provider calls, realistic estimates, integration failures, and the 0.2.1 release path.

outcomes.statement: Provider-call preflight accounts for primary, verification, retry, and consolidation calls and identifies bounded versus best-effort estimates.
GitHub PR ingestion enforces file and byte budgets fail-closed before unbounded content downloads.
Ollama requests have a deadline and GitHub GET retries are limited to transient failures.
GitHub PR metadata pagination is capped and truncation is reported as unreviewed input.
The package is versioned at 0.2.1, examples pin the release tag, and the package/release documentation remains consistent.
Integration coverage exercises timeout, rate-limit, non-transient GET, reporter posting, byte-budget, and metadata-limit failures.
The package typechecks, tests, documentation gates, and packs successfully.

tracking.reason: Local library fix; no external issue or PR transition is authorized by this task.
